text_read: Repaired digest consulted; then in the full source (Part A) read in full: 道身证验说 (l.166-170), 回光返照天机 (275-279), 真阳发生天机 (494-498), 阳光三现天机 (501-505), 神气皈根口诀, 止火口诀, 采大药天机真诀, 六根不漏天机口诀 (508-533), and the 魔境/邪水/邪火/赤蛇/雷神监坛/火焚禅坐/天花乱坠 sections (716-806); other sections by keyword grep.
mode_evidence: The yang light is located and described as seen: 'like lightning drawn in cloud, like the empty room producing white (云中掣电、虚室生白), first appearing before the brows'; at the second appearance light 'surges up from the abdomen to the eyes and shines, forcing both eyes open (直将二目催开)'. 九灵老人 insists these are 'not illusions, but real tests produced by true work' and 'not metaphor but real scenes (非比喻也，乃真景象也)'.
onset_evidence: Nothing is offered for inducing light as such. The light is a by-product and timing sign of the Wu-Liu hundred-day course: inner gaze/'returning the light' (回光返照, 塞兑垂帘) into the qi cavity, small-orbit firing on each 'living zi hour' erection, ~300 orbits. The first flash comes during refining of essence 'while fire is not yet sufficient'; the second only after genital retraction (马阴藏相/龟缩不举) and full 300 orbits; the third 'after a day or at the opposite hour' of stillness. Light seen before the bodily signs 'is certainly not the sprout of the great medicine, mostly arising from deluded thought (多属妄想而发)'. Prerequisites: celibacy, stopping leakage of essence; the text claims oral transmission (口口传).

conditions.posture: seated meditation; a wooden seat pressing the perineum, nose clip, tongue to palate during the seven-day gathering
conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: eyes lowered like a curtain (垂帘), 'eye-light' (眸光/二目阳光) fixed on the lower dantian/qi cavity
conditions.setting: quiet room; for gestation, secluded, away from noise
conditions.duration_and_schedule: practice at the zi hour after midnight when yang stirs; ~300 small orbits (the 'hundred days'); seven days and nights of unbroken gazing for the great medicine; ten months gestation
conditions.prerequisites: celibacy and cessation of seminal leakage; calming of mind first (炼心为主)
conditions.other: Women's method (late section) uses breasts and 'returning the light to the life palace'.

stages.label: 阳光一现 (first appearance)
stages.description: Lightning-like white flash between the brows during refining essence; fire not yet sufficient, continue firing orbits.

stages.label: 阳光二现 (second appearance)
stages.description: After genital retraction and 300 orbits, light surges from the abdomen to the eyes, 2-3 flashes, sometimes like a gold coin or red fire-pearl dripping; signal to stop the orbit fire and sit in stillness 'containing the light'.

stages.label: 阳光三现 (third appearance)
stages.description: After a day or twelve hours, the same light again flashes between the brows from the dantian: 'moonlight bright on the south-west road'; stop fire at once and gather the great medicine over seven days. A fourth appearance means the medicine is lost.

stages.label: 道身证验 / 胎中景
stages.description: Later: red haze over crown, lightning in the eyes, organs seen within 'as by candlelight', body like a crystal pagoda, golden light enveloping body; after union of sun and moon a wheel-sized auspicious light from the crown, bright day and night; after gestation 'nature-light', purple mist and a ball of golden light over the body.

what_to_do_with_light: Use as a timing sign only; at the second appearance stop circulating and 'hold the light' in stillness (含光静养); at the later visions, do not look at it (不可看他), 'kill the mind' and enter samadhi; ignore all apparitions.
obstacles_and_fixes: Light appearing without genital retraction: false, from deluded thought and insufficient fire; keep firing.
Continuing the fire past the third appearance (a fourth appearance) loses the medicine.
During gestation, visions of water (黄石公) mean dantian fire has gone cold and dan-light has vanished; fix by gaze-fixing and visualizing a blazing true fire filling the cauldron with spirit-light.

Uncontrollable visions of fire/flames from the seven orifices (李虚庵/尹大真人): visualize a cold black ball the size of a cartwheel in the space before you and draw it into the belly, repeating until the false fire subsides.
cautions: Light without the bodily sign is 妄想 and not a true sign.
All visions (heavens, hells, demons, thunder-gods) are to be met with a dead-still mind; the 'thunder god' is the discursive mind (识神) trying to frighten you.
Stopping fire too early or too late both ruin the work.
interpretation: The light is the dan's own radiance (丹光/阳光), the outward sign that pre-heaven yang qi has fully gathered in the qi root; true only when accompanied by the bodily sign of retraction.
practice_summary: Calm the mind first; sit, lower the eyelids, close the senses and turn the gaze inward onto the lower dantian (回光返照). Each time yang stirs after midnight, run a small heavenly circuit with breath and intent, and keep a count of good circuits toward 300. A white, lightning-like flash between the brows during this phase is the first appearance: it means the fire is not yet sufficient; keep going. Only when the genitals retract and stay unaroused, and light surges from the belly to the eyes, flashing two or three times, has the second appearance come: stop the circulating fire, sit in deep stillness and hold the light without effort. Within a day or so the light flashes a third time between the brows; then begin the seven-day gathering with the eye-light fixed unbroken on the qi cavity. Light that comes without the bodily sign is delusion. In later stages, whatever luminous visions arise, do not look at them; stay in samadhi.

key_passages.locator: 真阳发生天机 (达摩祖师曰), source line 496
key_passages.anchor: 纵 有 外 光 发 现 必 非 大 药 之 苗 也 多 属 妄 想 而 发 火 候 未 足
key_passages.paraphrase: Even if outer light appears [before true retraction], it is certainly not the sprout of the great medicine; it mostly arises from deluded thought and the fire is not yet sufficient.
key_passages.quote: 龟头缩入腹里，不得认为火足；纵有外光发现，必非大药之苗也，多属妄想而发、火候未足。

key_passages.locator: 真阳发生天机, source line 496
key_passages.anchor: 丹 放 毫 光 如 云 中 掣 电 虚 室 生 白 之 状 初 发 现 于 眉 前
key_passages.paraphrase: The dan emits rays of light, like lightning drawn through clouds, like an empty room producing whiteness; first seen before the brows, later rising from the lower field to the eyes, flashing bright: this is the first appearance.
key_passages.quote: 若真能马阴藏相，龟头缩回，丹放毫光，如云中掣电、虚室生白之状，初发现于眉前，久则自下田上达于目，光明闪烁，即阳光一现之景到也。

key_passages.locator: 真阳发生天机, source line 496
key_passages.anchor: 忽 觉 坤 田 之 内 丹 光 上 涌 外 达 于 目 而 生 辉 直 将 二 目 催 开
key_passages.paraphrase: At the second appearance, in stillness, dan-light suddenly surges up in the abdomen to the eyes and shines, forcing the eyes open, flashing two or three times, sometimes bright as a gold coin or red as a fire-pearl; do not run the orbit fire again; enter samadhi and nourish the light.
key_passages.quote: 静定之中，忽觉坤田之内，丹光上涌，外达于目而生辉，直将二目催开，光耀闪烁，一连二三次而后已，或丹光涌出，明如金钱，赤如火珠

key_passages.locator: 阳光三现天机 (华阳禅师曰), source line 503
key_passages.anchor: 常 常 温 养 刻 刻 凝 照 以 待 阳 光 三 现
key_passages.paraphrase: After stopping the fire, never leave the fire: constantly warm and nourish, moment by moment concentrate the gaze, to await the third appearance, which comes after a day or twelve hours; stop at once then, or a fourth appearance loses the medicine.
key_passages.quote: 阳光二现，火足止火，虽不行周天升降之火，时刻不可须臾离火，常常温养，刻刻凝照，以待阳光三现。

key_passages.locator: 道身证验说 (九灵老人曰), source line 168
key_passages.anchor: 内 观 脏 腑 朗 如 烛 照 通 体 上 下 如 水 晶 宝 塔
key_passages.paraphrase: Among verifications: seeing a needle through a wall at night, red haze circling the crown, lightning in the eyes, inner viewing of the organs bright as by candlelight, the body like a crystal pagoda covered in golden light; insisted to be real, not illusion.
key_passages.quote: 黑夜隔壁见针……顶上红霞旋绕，眼中电光闪烁……内观脏腑，朗如烛照，通体上下，如水晶宝塔，金光罩体……皆非幻化，尽是真功做出实验

key_passages.locator: 火焚禅坐危险详说 (尹大真人云), source line 788
key_passages.anchor: 面 前 太 虚 空 中 有 一 团 黑 球 大 如 车 轮 其 冷 如 冰
key_passages.paraphrase: Remedy for runaway fire-light: visualize in the space before you a black ball as big as a cartwheel, ice-cold, draw it into the belly; repeat three to five times until the false fire is gone.
